data.name: Daza
data.gender_notes: Daza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'dawaa' which means 'call' or 'invitation'. Daza symbolizes a blooming flower, inviting love and beauty into one's life. The name Daza carries the meaning “Blooming” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Daza usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encouragement and support from the divine.
data.etymology: Daza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blooming.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daza total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
